technical_spec.stop_placement_explanation: Monitor-only structural invalidation floor ($33.00) anchored near Bear Case equity value ($31.22) below Pivot S2 ($44.49) and the 52-week low ($47.94). No live position is authorized.
technical_spec.valuation_assessment: Fails valuation and cash-flow hurdles. Standalone 2027 FCF yields 4.58% versus 5.04% 10-year Treasuries, Pivot S2 ($44.49) sits above $39.67 EIA strip value, and a Stage 2 reclaim sits above $50.00 Base fair value.
technical_spec.posture_explanation: The Stage 4 CAP_REJECTED ceiling aligns with Pass 2 valuation math. New capital stays locked at REJECTED.

sizing_table_takeaway: With EQT assigned REJECTED (TIER_0), initial allocation stays at 0.0% of net worth. At $48.89 CMP (0.07:1 R:R to $50.00 Base against a $33.00 stop) or Pivot S2 ($44.49, 0.48:1 R:R), EQT fails the 1.50:1 gate; only a below-strip washout to $36.00–$38.00 paired with >$3.00/MMBtu normalized gas, HSR clearance, PipeBox paydown, and Stage 1/2 reclaim reopens the file.
primer: EQT Corporation runs 28.0 Tcfe of low-cost Marcellus reserves with owned Equitrans gathering at a ~$2.00/MMBtu breakeven. However, Blackstone's PipeBox JV sweeps 60% of midstream cash ($3.3B remaining), alongside $13.2B in pipe commitments and $2.50/Dth short puts. The Range Resources merger also carries federal HSR antitrust review and an asymmetric $1,148M reverse break-up fee. At $48.89 in Stage 4 Markdown, standalone 2027 FCF yields 4.58% at EIA's $2.88/MMBtu forecast, trailing 5.04% 10-year Treasuries. Because expected value ($48.37, Bear $31.22) implies -1.1% return and Pivot S2 ($44.49) sits above $39.67 strip value, we assign REJECTED (TIER_0) and stay NOT_HELD.
